translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Asaa Iitatetsaa
Aasi sa'aa bollan dareedda wode, unttunttoo mac'c'a naanay yeletteeddino;
«Saluwaa Med'etatuwaa»
geetettiyaawanttu ha asaa mac'c'a naanay malaa lo"a gidiyaawaa be'eeddino; yaatiide unttunttuppe barenttoo dooreeddawantta akkeeddino.
Med'inaa Goday, «Ta Ayyaanay asan med'inaw de'enna; ayaw gooppe, Asay hayk'k'iyaawaa; Aa laytsatuukka itti s'eetanne laatama gidana» yaageedda.
He wodenne hewaappe guyye Saluwaa med'etatuu asaa mac'c'a naanaa akkina, naanay yeletteedda wode, wogga adussa asatuu sa'aa bollan de'eeddino. Unttunttune beni wode olaw minanne eretteedda asaa.
Med'inaa Goday he wode sa'aa bollan de'iyaa asaa iitatetsay dareeddawaanne unttunttu wozanay k'oppiyaabay ubbay ubbaa wodekka iita s'alala gideeddawaa be'eedda;
Med'inaa Goday asaa ha sa'aa bollan med'd'eeddawoo kayyotteedda; bare wozanaan loytsi seeletteedda.

Hewaa diraw Med'inaa Goday, «Taani med'd'eedda asaa ha sa'aa bollappe mule d'ayssana; asaa, mehiyaa, do'aa, biittaana gooshettiyaa med'etatuwaanne saluwaa kafotuwaa d'ayssana; ayaw gooppe, taani unttuntta med'd'eeddawoo kayyottaad» yaageedda.
Shin Nohe Med'inaa Godaa sintsan nashetteedda.
Noha
Nohe haneeddabay hawaappe kaalliide s'aafetteedda. Nohe s'illo asaa; I bare wodiyaan de'eedda asaa giddon suure asaa; Nohe S'oossanna hametteedda.
Nohe Seema, Kaamanne Yaafeeta giyaa heezzu attuma naanaa yeleedda.
He wode biittay sa'ay S'oossaa sintsan tuneedda; sa'ay ubbay makkalan kumeedda.
S'oossay ha sa'aa s'eelleedda; sa'ay tuneeddawaa be'eedda; ayaw gooppe, sa'aan de'iyaa Asay ubbay bare ogiyaa tunissi wotseedda.
Hewaa diraw, S'oossay Noha hawaadan yaagiide azazeedda; «Taani asaa ubbaa d'ayssana hanay; unttunttu gaasuwaan sa'ay makkalan kumeedda diraw, taani tumuppe asaakka sa'aakka d'ayssana.
Hewaa diraw, mino mitsaappe new markkabiyaa kees's'a; he markkabiyaa giddon c'ora k'ol"otuwaa kessa; yaataade soonnanne karenna shidiyaan bara.
Markkabiyaa hawaadan yaataade kees's'a; adussatetsaa heezzu s'eetu wad'aa, gomppaa ishatamu wad'aa, geesaa hattamu wad'aa ootsa;
markkabiyaw kaaraa
med'd'a; kaaraappenne godaappe gidduwaan itti wad'aa gidiyaa sa'aa kallo agga basha; penggiyaa markkabiyaw miyiyaanna kessa; markkabiyaa heezzu pook'iyaa kessaade kees's'a.
«Taani saluwaappe garssan de'uwaa shemppuwaanna de'iyaa med'etaa ubbaa d'ayssanaw, ha sa'aa bollan bashshaa haatsaa yeddana; ha sa'aan de'iyaabay ubbay d'ayana.
Shin taani ta k'aalaa c'aak'k'uwaa neenana c'aak'k'ettana. Neeni ne machchatto, ne attuma naanaanne ne attuma naanaa machatuwaa neenanna akkaade markkabiyaa giddo gela.
Unttunttu neenana shemppuwaanna attana mala, shemppuu de'iyaa med'etaa ubbaappe k'ommuwaan k'ommuwaan attumawaanne mac'c'awaa laa"uwaa laa"uwaa akkaade, markkabiyaa giddo gelissa.
Dumma dumma k'ommo kafuwaappe, dumma dumma k'ommo mehiyaappenne biittaana gooshettiyaa dumma dumma k'ommo med'etatuwaa ubbaappe laa"uwaa laa"uwaa gidiide, shemppuwaanna attana mala neekko yaana.
K'ay neeninne neenanna de'iyaawanttu maanaw, dumma dumma k'ommu miyaa katsaa Eefeera, markkabiyaa giddon k'ola» yaageedda.
Nohe ubbabaakka S'oossay azazeeddawaadan ootseedda.

footnotes.text: Saluwaa Med'etatuwaa: S'oossaa naanatuwaa; s'oossatuwaa naanatuwaa.
